data.name: SCP: ReEnter
data.detailed_description:
SCP: ReEnter is a free-to-play, multiplayer first-person survival and action game set during a catastrophic containment breach in a secure Foundation facility. At the start of each round, all players are randomly assigned to either the Human team or the SCP Anomaly team. This creates a high-stakes asymmetrical battle where objectives are dynamic and team alliances are crucial.

The Human team is further divided into factions, each with a unique goal in the chaos:

  • The Foundation (MTF): Your goal is to secure the facility, rescue the Scientists, and terminate all hostile SCP Anomalies.

  • The Liberated (Chaos Insurgency): Your goal is to work together to facilitate the escape of all Class D Personnel.

  • Scientists & Class D: Your goal is to escape the facility alive!

The SCP Anomaly team has a singular goal: prevent all human escape and terminate everyone!

With seven terrifying and unique playable SCPs and diverse human classes, every round offers chaotic and unpredictable action across the entire facility.

Key Features:

  • Asymmetrical Multiplayer FPS: A round begins with all players randomly assigned to either the Human or SCP Anomaly team.

  • Dynamic Factions and Objectives: Play as a Mobile Task Force member rescuing Scientists, a Class D prisoner fighting alongside the Chaos Insurgency to escape, or a hostile SCP Anomaly dedicated to slaughter.

  • Diverse Playable SCPs: Take control of seven iconic anomalies: SCP-049 (The Plague Doctor), SCP-049-2 (Zombie), SCP-096 (The Shy Guy), SCP-106 (The Old Man), SCP-173 (The Sculpture), SCP-939 (With Many Voices), and SCP-966 (The Sleepwalker).

  • Intense Survival and Combat: As a human, scavenge for keycards and weapons, and use a detailed Weapon Modification system to customize your gear for an edge in combat.

  • Three Underground Zones & Surface: Navigate the massive containment site across the Light Containment Zone (LCZ), Heavy Containment Zone (HCZ), the Entrance Zone (EZ), and the Surface.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 4-core processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6-core processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 12

  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent and intense violence and blood. Players engage in combat using firearms, and monstrous entities (SCPs) attack and kill human characters in graphic ways.

The game also features strong psychological horror elements, including jump scares, dark and oppressive environments, and a pervasive atmosphere of fear and dread.

As an online multiplayer game, players may also be exposed to strong language from other users via voice or text chat.
